T+0 Delivery & Guidance Raise

Balance Sheet & Liquidity Fortress

Following the closing of the Thermal Management sale and strong Q3 operations, cash and cash equivalents surged to $1,121.8M (vs $237.5M at Dec 31, 2025). Net leverage stands at a conservative 1.1x net debt to EBITDA, creating over $2.0B in available capital deployment capacity.

• 3-Month Q3 Free Cash Flow printed at $267.9M (+6% YoY), achieving a 107% conversion rate of adjusted net income.
• Share repurchases totaled $100.2M YTD with a newly approved $0.21/share quarterly cash dividend payable Nov 6, 2026.
Forensic Assessment: High earnings quality. Working capital absorption is minimal, SBC dilution is negligible (<1% of sales), and cash flow expansion matches GAAP operating profit growth point-for-point.
Row 4: Operational Execution Audit & Analyst Q&A Highlights
WINS / DRAGS & ANALYST Q&A
What Management Did Right (Operational Tailwinds)
  • Explosive Liquid Cooling Growth: Systems Protection organic growth hit +54%, propelled by Data Solutions multiplying threefold with tier-1 hyperscaler cluster deployments.
  • Aggressive Guidance Raise: Upwardly revised full-year reported sales growth to 48%-49% and EPS to $5.36-$5.39, decisively signaling resilient secular demand.
  • Maverick Power Catalyst: Closed on October 1st, establishing an integrated utility-to-chip power skid and modular busway offering that commands higher margin capture.
  • Operating Margin Expansion: Adjusted ROS expanded 190 bps YoY to 22.1%, showing strong factory operating leverage despite supply chain scaling.
What Went Wrong & Execution Headwinds
  • Headline Revenue Missed Whisper: Sales of $1,514.9M came in 1.6% below consensus ($1,540.0M) and below the $1,575.0M whisper bogey, prompting initial intraday profit taking.
  • Electrical Connections Softness: Segment revenue of $416.9M missed $440.0M expectations, reflecting subdued non-residential commercial building construction in EMEA.
  • Electrical Connections Margin Compression: Segment Adjusted ROS contracted 180 bps YoY to 28.2%, impacted by copper raw material inflation and product mix shifts.
  • M&A Integration Risk: Integrating Maverick Power and Trachte simultaneously across multiple manufacturing footprints creates short-term operational complexity.
Institutional Conference Call Analyst Q&A Forensic Highlights
Julian Mitchell (Barclays) AI Data Center Liquid Cooling Capacity & Order Visibility

Question: How much of the 54% organic growth in Systems Protection is coming from direct-to-chip CDUs versus traditional air-cooled enclosures, and are you seeing any capacity constraints in your liquid cooling facilities?

Executive Answer: Beth Wozniak (CEO) confirmed that Data Solutions grew over 100% YoY, with liquid cooling orders multiplying threefold. She highlighted that nVent added 40% manufacturing capacity in 2026 and customer order backlogs provide firm visibility through late 2027 across tier-1 hyperscalers.

Deane Dray (RBC Capital Markets) Maverick Power Acquisition Synergy & Grid-to-Chip Offering

Question: Can you quantify the top-line contribution expected from Maverick Power in Q4, and how does combining busway and switchgear with liquid cooling differentiate nVent against Vertiv and Eaton?

Executive Answer: Sara Zawoyski (CFO) stated Maverick adds ~19 points of growth in Q4 (~$190M-$200M annualized run-rate) and broadens nVent's portfolio into a unified 'utility-to-chip' platform. Data center builders can now procure pre-fabricated modular power skids integrated directly with nVent cooling manifolds.

Jeffrey Sprague (Vertical Research Partners) Capital Allocation & Balance Sheet Firepower Post-Thermal Sale

Question: With cash balances reaching $1.12B following the Thermal Management sale and robust Q3 free cash flow ($268M), what is the capital deployment hierarchy between M&A, buybacks, and debt repayment?

Executive Answer: Sara Zawoyski noted net leverage is down below 1.2x, providing over $2.0B in balance sheet dry powder. Management prioritizes accretive electrical bolt-on acquisitions in power and grid infrastructure, complemented by opportunistic share repurchases ($100M executed YTD) and sustained dividend growth.
